purpose: Keyword-driven game environment concept images. Not an app-development task.
generation_reference_selection: Masters 01-04 v2.7: preserve the original 19 and 5 scoped LDI architectural supplements, plus 3 user-added optional references (27 master images). Select a small role-labeled set; for a new scene balance composition/layout, architectural rendering and a Master04 world-design image before redundant style images or generated-result examples. M03-10 remains representative; select an additional scene-relevant LDI supplement when capacity allows. Consult docs/05_GENERATION_RULES.md for tool limits and scoped result reuse. M01/M02 govern basic geometry, mandatory single orthographic projection, perpendicular boundaries and continuous walking volumes. Compare final art to a scene-specific structure guide. M02 supplies functional direction/connectivity, not fixed gate locations; main straight building structure follows common XY axes; grounded curved walls are allowed with clear visual boundaries; roof surfaces and curve tangents are inspected separately. The mandatory orthographic rule overrides every reference camera including M01; geometry references govern base/framing/connectivity; art and world references exclude their own camera/layout. A supplied guide is a visual cue, not a hard geometric constraint. M03-16/M03-17/M04-08 are scoped optional masters. Explicit filename/ID selection applies to the current request; registration alone does not change global priorities, the LDI rendering baseline or Salvage Cyberpunk world, or mandate cassette futurism in every image. Apply Master03 v2.2 clean broad planes and sparse broad flat directional brushwork even on intact surfaces. B03-01 is optional surface-only support, never a new global priority; B03-02/03/04 are approved surface comparison examples, not automatic generation inputs or geometry anchors. Record the actual inputs and their assigned roles. F-01~07 are optional large-form/facade-depth references, not camera or rendering references; do not submit all seven by default. F-08~11 are form comparison examples only, not automatic generation inputs; preserve their needs_revision QA and do not promote their geometry.
limits: Reference instructions guide image generation but do not guarantee geometry. Original master style/world must not be changed by interpreting a preferred example as replacement.
requested_scene_count_semantics: final_deliverables; structural correction attempts are preserved separately

structural_correction_policy.pass_gate: All applicable structural checks including mandatory final orthographic projection PASS; any FAIL => needs_revision; critical uncertainty => uncertain.
structural_correction_policy.global_geometry_fault_strategy: Rebuild common structure without preserving faulty geometry; zoom-out alone is not geometry correction. Retain the intended large-form design (curves, projections, L wings and mechanical storeys) while rebuilding its common projection; do not flatten every design into boxes.

scene_interpretation: New location keywords redesign building function, masses, layout, paving and subsurface infrastructure under unchanged spatial constraints; do not inherit prior scene-only props, weather or the same cutaway design. Explicit edits preserve the requested aspects of their target. Interpret city, alley, market by distinct building purposes, silhouettes/depth and street relationships. L shape, second-storey machinery, 40%/20%, half-size upper home, building counts, poles/cars, lighting/palette are current-request values only. Two outputs require independently designed visible forms and layout, not just mirrors or recoloring; no fixed variation count.

scoped_result_examples.allowed_use: Aspect-only comparison; vary actual infrastructure by location. No whole-image approval.
Relative visual presence only, no fixed percentage or exact buildings/devices. A new location must be redesigned.
Surface treatment comparison only; preserve original needs_revision QA and exclude layout/geometry from approval.

geometry_policy.spatial_frame: single cubic virtual space with shared XYZ axes and scale
geometry_policy.default_base_footprint: square; shape exceptions require explicit user request
geometry_policy.base_geometry: four-corner plane extruded by consistent depth; corresponding vertical corners and planar front cuts
geometry_policy.rear_boundaries: two adjacent perpendicular back-boundary directions, expressed through buildings or other blocking objects; one functional exit per direction
geometry_policy.routes: reserve approach and post-clear/open-state passage volume to each transition; planned lock is distinct from accidental obstruction
geometry_policy.interior: when applicable, room depth and entry-to-functional-space circulation
workflow: Record mandatory single orthographic camera; shared-coordinate large forms, facade depth, straight/curved ground boundaries and separate roof/support plan
Check common axes for straight structure, coherent curves, unchanged square base corners, grounding and visually continuous routes; plan visible evidence
Assign two functional exit roles, positions, forms, states and post-clear connections
Compile requirement-covered prompt and transmit role-labeled guide/reference inputs
Inspect actual final image parallel same-world-axis line families, depth-invariant scale and constant-depth corner vectors under orthographic projection, then traversal and art
geometry_policy.building_footprints: Main arrangement and straight structural segments follow common XY axes. Rounded ground corners, curved facades and rounded machine-like buildings are allowed with readable grounding and walking/blocking boundaries. No arbitrary oblique building rotation, ambiguous wedge gaps or implausible joints. Curve tangents are distinct from level axis lines; do not wrap every curved building in a rectangular plinth or impose curve counts/radii.
geometry_policy.prop_shape_exception: tanks/vehicles/props may be curved or rotated; same camera, grounding and clear exit routes required
geometry_policy.roof_geometry: varied roof profiles allowed; explicit plane/surface joins, wall-top alignment and supported equipment; uncertainty is not PASS
geometry_policy.reference_camera_priority: Mandatory orthographic projection overrides all reference cameras, including M01; preserve assigned structure/art/world roles.
geometry_policy.collision_scope: Actual collider/mesh/UV construction and validation belong to a separately requested later 3D task. Their absence does not fail or hold current concept art; inspect visible grounding, support, boundary clarity and walking continuity.

rooftop.allowed: purposeful equipment, props or functional architectural elements with credible support and connections
rooftop.applies_to: buildings only; do not impose roof occupancy on tanks/vehicles
rooftop.mechanical_storey_application: Keep per-building functional roof composition at 40–80%, distinct from requested facade/storey machinery proportions. Choose supported useful elements; do not add redundant machinery above a machinery storey merely to satisfy coverage, or repeat the same tanks/panels.

architectural_design_policy.form_options: Choose purpose-driven L/T/U wings, unequal widths/heights, setbacks/projections, deep openings, stairs, balconies, decks, supported curved housings and roof profiles. Use only suitable choices; no mandatory feature bundle or fixed number of variants.
architectural_design_policy.mechanical_storey: When requested or functionally appropriate, machinery may form a cladding shell, frame, plant annex or an entire nonhabitable storey. A mechanical second storey is that storey itself, not a residential second storey plus rooftop props. Ground-level human access remains building-specific.

functional_exit_policy.position_per_side: center/intermediate/end, symmetric or asymmetric; no fixed coordinates or forced alternation
functional_exit_policy.state: record pre-clear locked or post-clear open; preserve approach, opening clearance and usable post-clear connection
functional_exit_policy.count_by: assigned traversal function, not visible door count
functional_exit_policy.accidental_obstruction: Do not retroactively label a fence/stock blocking a planned open route as an intended locked exit.

boundary_object_policy.requirements: readable blocking role along two rear directions; no unintended third route; protect center and designated exits; use legible connected blocking masses, not tiny low props; buildings are optional boundary carriers. Maintain central combat space with scene-appropriate street widths, not the same oversized empty courtyard everywhere.

execution_prompt_policy.compile: Remove history and duplicate explanation; retain every applicable requirement through a coverage ledger. Do not append all master documents verbatim.
execution_prompt_policy.record: Exact submitted prompt, character/UTF-8 byte counts, actual reference paths/count/roles, confirmed tool contract and unknown limits separately.
execution_prompt_policy.independent_outputs: When the user requests independent variants, each starts from masters and its own scene plan; never feed one generated variant into the other.

geometry_review_policy.parallel_projection: Compare same-world-axis line families across base top/bottom, paving, building footings, wall tops and level roof edges. Corresponding top/bottom corner displacement vectors of a constant-depth base must agree. Equal actual lengths in the same 3D direction retain screen length at every depth. Also compare footings, floor edges, shutter horizontal lines, terrace beams and upper walls against matching ground-axis lines; internally coherent building lines can still contradict the scene camera.
geometry_review_policy.observations: Record native image dimensions, line endpoints, world-axis assignment, visibility, uncertainty and justified verdict; screen-angle differences are not measured 3D rotation.
geometry_review_policy.occlusion: Critical hidden footing/corner evidence remains UNCERTAIN. Prefer legible ground contacts when planning.
geometry_review_policy.exclude_false_matches: Distinguish true horizontal straight structural edges from roof slopes, awnings, shadows, rotated props and curved-building tangent lines. Partial occlusion alone does not prove building rotation or wall tilt.
geometry_review_policy.reassessments: Preserve prior outputs and reviews; a new evidenced review supersedes a prior PASS. Failed or uncertain geometry is not a positive geometry reference.
geometry_review_policy.future_modeling: For exact geometry, separately retain a validated 3D blockout and camera as the authority. A 2D guide or coordinate JSON does not constrain the image generator as a geometry engine.
geometry_review_policy.perspective_result_policy: FAIL when perspective convergence or depth-based scaling contradicts orthographic projection, even if perspective is coherent; missing critical evidence is UNCERTAIN.
geometry_review_policy.collision_mesh_uv_scope: Actual collider/mesh/UV construction and validation belong to a separately requested later 3D task. Their absence does not fail or hold current concept art; inspect visible grounding, support, boundary clarity and walking continuity.

tool_input_evidence_policy.limits_source: Record the current tool contract. The documented maximum of 5 for num_last_images_to_include must not be transferred to referenced_image_paths.

latest_reassessments.role: diagnostic_only; supersedes prior candidate_pass without rewriting original records

surface_style_policy.base: Large calm clean base-color planes remain dominant and readable.
surface_style_policy.positive_treatment: Add selected sparse broad directional flat pigment strokes/patches in neighboring hue and value, including intact wall, road, roof and vehicle/body surfaces.
surface_style_policy.weathering_relationship: Brushwork is pictorial color variation, independent of rust, grime, peeling or damage; do not require damage to justify a stroke.
surface_style_policy.stroke_scale: Vary with the size and direction of each surface; no fixed pixel size or area percentage.

architecture_form_policy.approved_scope: large building forms, facade depth, purposeful reuse and structural machinery; preserve 01/02 geometry and 03/04 art/world roles
